title: Cheeblest and the Sister of Storms | Read Along | Luna Story Time
description:
When a mysterious sister summons a storm and threatens Castle Everstair, Cheeblest helps her friends look beyond the mask and see the lonely dream hidden inside.

Book Three of the Castle Everstair stories. Written with love by Luna and Sunny.

Listen and follow the highlighted words through this illustrated read-along, with a gentle original score.
